| **Likelihood** | plausible — Frozen junior hiring, AI-written code with lower delivery stability and unverified agent swarms are already visible, though the full hollowing-out and systemic shock lie ahead. |
| **Assessed** | 2026-11-27 |

AI execution becomes nearly free but human capacity to verify it does not scale, so unverified output floods the economy, junior career ladders collapse and experts codify their own replacement. Measured GDP soars while real value to people hollows out.

## Social contract scores (draft)

| Promise | Score | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hard work pays | 1 | Wages for measurable work fall to compute cost regardless of training, junior hiring freezes, average expertise collapses and displaced workers are told to exit. |
| Affordable essentials | 2 | Unverified agent output crowds out real consumption and leaves people starved of functioning infrastructure, though measurable goods get cheaper; housing, food and care are not discussed. |
| Reliable safety net |  | Not addressed: the paper says nothing on income support, unemployment insurance or how they are funded. |
| Responsive government | 1 | The end-state is a complete hollowing-out of human control, with a succession event ceding stewardship to AI a real risk. |
| Time for what matters |  | Not addressed: decaying human agency is the theme, but nothing on time for family, community or meaning. |
